voiceover: Diwali is four weeks away. Is your society fire-ready? Diyas and candles — keep every flame away from curtains and decorations. Crackers only on open ground, never near parked vehicles or gas cylinders. Check every extinguisher: gauge in the green, refilled this year. Hydrant landing valves clear, fire duct doors shut, refuge areas and staircases free of storage. Book your pre-Diwali fire check now — free site inspection, AMC quote in thirty minutes. DM us, or visit assafetyzone dot com. Have a safe, bright Diwali.
caption:
Diwali is 4 weeks away 🪔 Is your society fire-ready?
Diyas away from curtains, crackers on open ground only, extinguisher gauges in the green, hydrant valves and duct doors clear, refuge areas free of storage — a 10-minute walk-round now beats a 2 AM emergency.
Our team does pre-Diwali fire checks for housing societies across Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai, Mira-Bhayandar and Vasai-Virar — 150+ societies already on AMC.

flow_prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic shot, a Mumbai high-rise housing society compound at dusk, rows of lit clay diyas along balcony railings and the compound wall, warm fairy lights on the building, slow dolly-in, realistic photography, warm tones, no text, no readable signs, no close-up faces

Vertical 9:16 close-up, a single lit clay diya on an apartment window sill, a sheer white curtain moving gently in the breeze dangerously close to the flame, shallow depth of field, warm evening light, slow push-in, realistic, no text

Vertical 9:16, adult hands holding lit sparklers in an open housing-society compound at night, a steel bucket of water and sand on the ground beside them, parked cars far away in the background, festive bokeh lights, realistic, no faces, no text

Vertical 9:16 macro, a red ABC dry-powder fire extinguisher mounted on a corridor wall of an Indian residential building, pressure gauge needle in the green zone, a technician's gloved hand tapping the gauge and checking the tag, clean modern corridor, realistic, no readable text

Vertical 9:16, a fire hydrant cabinet in an Indian residential building stairwell with a red landing valve and hose reel, then a steel fire duct door swinging shut, well-lit clean corridor, slow pan, realistic, no text

Vertical 9:16, a clean, empty refuge floor and open staircase of a modern Indian high-rise housing society, no stored items, green exit sign glowing, a safety inspector in a reflective vest walking through, realistic, no readable text, no logos

Vertical 9:16, a fire-safety technician in a reflective orange vest and white helmet checking a fire alarm control panel and a ceiling sprinkler head in a housing-society lobby, clipboard in hand, warm Diwali lights visible through the glass door behind, realistic, no readable text, no logos

shot_list: 1. Society compound at dusk, diyas on railings — 3.5 s (hook)
